# Vendored front-end libraries

Downloaded once (2026-11-07) so the store works fully offline. Nothing is loaded from a CDN at runtime.

| Library | Version | Files | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bootstrap | 5.3.8 | `bootstrap/bootstrap.min.css`, `bootstrap/bootstrap.bundle.min.js` | MIT |
| Bootstrap Icons | 1.13.2 | `bootstrap-icons/bootstrap-icons.min.css`, `bootstrap-icons/fonts/*` | MIT |
| GSAP (+ ScrollTrigger, Flip) | 3.15.1 | `gsap/gsap.min.js`, `gsap/ScrollTrigger.min.js`, `gsap/Flip.min.js` | GSAP Standard "no charge" licence |
| Lenis | 1.3.27 | `lenis/lenis.min.js`, `lenis/lenis.css` | MIT |

Fonts live in `static/fonts/` (Bricolage Grotesque variable 5.3.0 and Source Serif 4 variable 5.3.1 from Fontsource, SIL OFL 1.1; licence files alongside).
